title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water according to package instructions until al dente.
While pasta cooks, fry pancetta in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
In a bowl, whisk together eggs, Pecorino, and Parmesan. Season with black pepper.
Reserve 1 cup pasta cooking water, then drain pasta.
Remove skillet from heat. Add hot pasta to pancetta, toss well.
Pour egg mixture over pasta, tossing quickly. Add pasta water as needed to create a creamy sauce.
Serve immediately with extra cheese and black pepper.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and half the spice mix for at least 1 hour.
Grill or pan-fry marinated chicken until cooked through and slightly charred.
In a large pot, melt butter and sauté onion until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, and remaining spices. Cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add canned tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend the sauce until smooth, then return to the pot.
Add cream and grilled chicken. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with naan or rice.

title: Avocado Toast
summary: Creamy smashed avocado on toasted sourdough bread topped with eggs and seasonings.
instructions: Toast sourdough bread until golden and crispy.
Halve avocado, remove pit, and scoop flesh into a bowl.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Poach or fry eggs to your preference.
Spread avocado mixture generously on toast.
Top each slice with an egg.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle red pepper flakes to serve.

title: Beef Tacos
summary: Seasoned ground beef in crispy taco shells with fresh salsa, cheese, and sour cream.
instructions: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart.
Drain excess fat from the beef.
Add taco seasoning and water per packet instructions. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Warm taco shells in oven per package directions.
Fill shells with seasoned beef.
Top with cheese, lettuce, tomato, salsa, and sour cream.
Serve immediately while shells are still crispy.
